caption: The VM writes only to the virtual disk and sends frames only to the vNIC. Behind those two: 12 thin volumes promise 18 TB inside 10 TB of RAID 5 (ratio 1.8), and 20 vNICs capped at 1 Gb/s each push 20 Gb/s onto a 10 Gb/s uplink (2:1).

spec.title: Worked example: disk chain and NIC chain
spec.aria: A virtual machine sits above two chains: a 1.5 TB thin virtual disk feeding a RAID 5 pool with 10 TB usable over 6 disks of 2 TB, marked 1.8 times overprovisioned, and a 1 Gb/s vNIC feeding a vSwitch to a 10 Gb/s uplink carrying 20 Gb/s of demand, marked 2 to 1 contention.
